legacybridge.saved_reports.title: Saved reports
legacybridge.saved_reports.warning: Historical data only — not approval to install or proof of activation.
legacybridge.saved_reports.select: Choose a report. Only new jobs with a saved index can reopen reports here. Existing receipts remain available in History. No JAR is opened or installed.
legacybridge.saved_reports.busy: Another operation is running or history needs refreshing. Try again after it finishes.
legacybridge.saved_reports.reading: Reading and checking the saved report…
legacybridge.saved_reports.hash_match: Matches saved hash; not proof of authenticity or gameplay.
legacybridge.saved_reports.sanitized: Display control characters removed; hash describes the original bytes.
legacybridge.saved_reports.error: Report unavailable (%s). %s No installation was attempted.
legacybridge.saved_reports.retry: Refresh history and check report permissions. Do not edit hashes to bypass a refusal.
legacybridge.saved_reports.missing: This job has no saved report index, or this report was never recorded. Older jobs retain their receipt view; report associations are not reconstructed.
legacybridge.saved_reports.changed: The report no longer matches its saved hash. Keep the original files and inspect the change before retrying.
legacybridge.saved_reports.limit: The report exceeds this viewer's size or parsing/time limits. It was not truncated or accepted as valid.
legacybridge.saved_reports.invalid: The report or index has invalid encoding, unsupported structure or exceeds JSON parsing limits. Preserve the files for technical inspection.
legacybridge.composition.review_hint: Data: validate an explicitly prepared local bundle, review its hash and declarations. Hashes do not authenticate the publisher or prove a mod compatible. A changed reviewed bundle is rejected until you review it again. No download or installation.
legacybridge.cohort.title: LegacyBridge — Group preview (advanced)
legacybridge.cohort.selection_hint: Check 1–4 input rows, then review the whole selection. Search-hidden checked rows are included. Only the audited fixture pair can pass today.
legacybridge.cohort.refused: Not started: another operation is active or the reviewed rows changed. Go Back, refresh and select again.
legacybridge.cohort.warning: Review every selected file before Inspect. This is a PRIVATE STATIC PREVIEW, not conversion for installation. No mod activates in this session.
legacybridge.cohort.data: A blank data field uses the included exact-pair contract, not generic mappings. An explicit bundle path overrides it; invalid explicit data never falls back. No automatic download or developer-cache lookup. Other advanced previews still require full data.
legacybridge.cohort.limits: Only the exact authored library + consumer fixture pair is implemented. Native classloader, behavior and multiplayer are NOT validated. No Convert or Apply authority is produced.
legacybridge.cohort.status.review: REVIEW — no processing started; inspect the frozen selection below
legacybridge.cohort.status.running: RUNNING — analyzing and building private target evidence
legacybridge.cohort.status.static_pair_v: STATIC_PAIR_VALIDATED — private pair checked and discarded, not installed or game-tested
legacybridge.cohort.status.blocked: BLOCKED — selected group failed the implemented contract; inspect diagnostics
legacybridge.cohort.status.failed: FAILED — operation/data error; correct the cause and retry
legacybridge.cohort.status.cancelled: CANCELLED — no approved pair or preview report published
legacybridge.cohort.selection: %s explicitly selected inputs, including any hidden by search:
legacybridge.cohort.linkage_checked: Source linkage was checked; consult the report for individual findings.
legacybridge.cohort.linkage_not_checked: Source linkage NOT checked. Missing evidence is not a pass.
legacybridge.cohort.omitted: %s additional diagnostics omitted from display; consult the full report.
legacybridge.cohort.gates: Remaining gates (not satisfied by this screen):
legacybridge.cohort.report_hint: Copy details includes local paths. The report contains the engine source/target proof and TransformationLog. No candidate JAR is retained. Back keeps this session unchanged; leaving the converter cancels work only before report publication wins.
legacybridge.composition.title: Advanced composition inspection
legacybridge.composition.warning: Inspection only: no converted JAR, installation or activation. Static validation is not gameplay proof.
legacybridge.composition.data: Requires an explicit full local mapping/API bundle in the previous screen. Blank is not enough; no hidden downloads.
legacybridge.composition.limits: Finite combination: existing owned-body logic + recipe/resource contracts. This is not a selectable conversion profile.
legacybridge.composition.busy: Inspection unavailable. Return, select a candidate and wait for other work to finish.
legacybridge.composition.report_hint: The JSON includes the engine's exact mappings/data hashes, adapter bindings and proposed TransformationLog when available. No changes were committed. Paths may be private; review before sharing.
legacybridge.composition.status.running: Inspecting on the bounded engine worker…
legacybridge.composition.status.preview_: Finite static preview validated — NOT CONVERTED.
legacybridge.composition.status.blocked: Static proof blocked. Inspect the engine diagnostic.
legacybridge.composition.status.failed: Inspection failed. Correct the input/data/path and retry.
legacybridge.composition.status.cancelle: Inspection cancelled; no preview result was published.
legacybridge.composition.gate.static_pro: Static proof has not passed for this input/data selection.
legacybridge.composition.gate.public_pro: This combination has no promoted public conversion profile.
legacybridge.composition.gate.installer_: Installer admission for composed artifacts is not implemented.
legacybridge.composition.gate.native_com: Isolated original/target behavior comparison remains pending.
legacybridge.composition.gate.final_pack: Final packaged client/server qualification remains pending.
legacybridge.history.title: Conversion history
legacybridge.history.search: Search input paths, job IDs, hashes or recorded states
legacybridge.history.warning: Recorded history only — activation NOT OBSERVED
legacybridge.history.inert_paths: Paths are text only; files and current installation are not verified.
legacybridge.history.details_warning: Historical receipts cannot approve Apply or closing the game. CONVERTED is not proof of gameplay.
legacybridge.history.snapshot_warning: Captured snapshot. Go back and Refresh to read new receipts. COMPLETE means only that the bounded scan finished.
legacybridge.history.ordering_hint: Receipt pages follow the reader's observed order. Legacy/ambiguous receipts have no established latest result.
legacybridge.history.busy: Another operation is busy. Refresh when it finishes.
legacybridge.history.reading: Reading history… previous snapshot remains visible
legacybridge.history.empty: No matching receipts. Clear search, Refresh or inspect Diagnostics.
legacybridge.history.recorded: Highest observed receipt: %s — not current status
legacybridge.history.no_latest: No trusted latest receipt — see details/diagnostics
legacybridge.history.display_limit: Display limit reached. Copy details to read the rest.
legacybridge.screen.title: LegacyBridge — Convert mods
legacybridge.screen.input: Input: <gameDir>/legacybridge/input — never put originals in mods
legacybridge.screen.mapping: Advanced: optional local mapping bundle; blank uses included simple-content contracts
legacybridge.screen.mapping_hint: Optional bundle path; blank = included simple-content contracts
legacybridge.screen.mapping_details: Leave blank for the included simple-content-v1 contracts. For advanced local data, enter an absolute bundle directory. An invalid explicit bundle is an error, never a fallback. No generic mappings or automatic downloads.
legacybridge.screen.empty: No candidates. Place a legacy JAR in input and refresh.
legacybridge.screen.data_required: MAPPING_DATA_REQUIRED: this operation needs explicit external data. The included contracts cover only simple-content-v1.
legacybridge.screen.no_install: Conversion only writes staging. Installation requires separate Apply confirmation; no hot loading or automatic restart.
legacybridge.screen.scroll: Scroll this panel to read results, errors and report paths.
legacybridge.screen.search: Search filenames, mod IDs or names
legacybridge.screen.search_hint: Search filenames, mod IDs or names (local inventory only)
legacybridge.screen.input_short: Originals: legacybridge/input — Forge does not load this folder
legacybridge.screen.no_matches: No matching rows. Check the input folder or search.
legacybridge.screen.selection_help: Space: check row | Ctrl+A: check filtered candidates | Tab: navigate
legacybridge.screen.selection_limit: At most 32 candidates can be checked.
legacybridge.screen.checked: Checked for conversion. Space changes this selection.
legacybridge.screen.unchecked: Not checked. Space selects this candidate.
legacybridge.screen.ineligible: Not eligible for the conversion queue. Details explain why.
legacybridge.screen.row_details: Press Enter to inspect this job's details.
legacybridge.screen.queue_refused: Queue request refused. Check the selection, data and 32-job limit.
legacybridge.screen.details_help: Arrows, Page Up/Down, Home/End or wheel scroll; Tab reaches actions.
legacybridge.screen.profile_limit: Only simple-content-v1, with its finite contracts included. This is not a generic mapping pack; analysis does not prove conversion support.
legacybridge.screen.risk_not_percentage: Risk score is a heuristic, not a compatibility percentage.
legacybridge.screen.restart_manual: Converted is not active. Applied results require closing Minecraft and reopening through your launcher; automatic restart is unavailable.
legacybridge.screen.job_not_retained: This job summary is no longer retained. Files were not deleted.

legacybridge.screen.open_unavailable: Open request unavailable; wait for completion or copy the path/details.
legacybridge.screen.open_compatibility_h: Open this job's own CompatibilityReport JSON
legacybridge.screen.open_transformations: Open this job's own TransformationLog JSON
legacybridge.screen.open_conversion_hint: Open this job's own conversion report JSON
legacybridge.screen.open_result_hint: Open the result folder; never execute/open a JAR association
legacybridge.screen.cancel_requested: Cancellation requested before publication; wait for the final job state.
legacybridge.screen.cancel_unavailable: Cancellation is unavailable after publication/application begins.

legacybridge.job.pending_restart: Applied — restart through your launcher required
legacybridge.install.title: LegacyBridge — Installation and recovery
legacybridge.install.entry_hint: Select staged results or inspect persistent transactions; opening this screen changes no installed file
legacybridge.install.associate_hint: Check one staged job and select a managed prior journal (up to four not-loaded files). The installer must match the verified mod ID; names are not evidence
legacybridge.install.updates_cleared: Replacement links cleared. Checked results now request add-only installation.
legacybridge.install.apply_close: Apply and close — reopen through your launcher
legacybridge.install.apply_close_hint: Close only after this confirmed transaction reports a safe completed result. This does not relaunch Minecraft.
legacybridge.install.world_open: WORLD_OPEN: leave the world or server before installing, recovering or closing through this action.
legacybridge.install.request_refused: Request refused. Inspect operation details, current selection and transaction state.
legacybridge.install.busy: Installation/recovery is running. Wait; navigation cannot cancel an accepted operation.
legacybridge.install.selection: %s / 4 checked | Space marks a staged result; Tab reaches actions
legacybridge.install.selection_limit: At most four staged results may be approved together.
legacybridge.install.transactions_hint: Journals are inspected asynchronously. Select one for per-file details or explicit recovery.
legacybridge.install.details_hint: Arrows, Page Up/Down, Home/End or wheel scroll; Back returns to the list.
legacybridge.install.empty: No retained rows. Convert a result or inspect existing journals.
legacybridge.install.not_active: A transaction state is not proof of activation. This screen does not change the running mod set.
legacybridge.install.shutdown_limit: OS close, force-kill and power loss cannot be vetoed by this screen. Recovery may require manual review; a batch is not one atomic filesystem change.
legacybridge.install.checked: Checked for installation. Space unchecks this result.
legacybridge.install.unchecked: Not checked for installation. Space checks this result.
legacybridge.install.ineligible: Not currently eligible for installation. Inspect the conversion result.
legacybridge.install.associate_warning:
%s
Prior journal: %s
Prior IDs: %s

Approve this managed update? Only the verified matching mod ID may be replaced; other entries remain unchanged. Loaded files are refused. This link does not install anything yet.
legacybridge.install.update_associated: Explicit update linked. Review the marked result and Apply to authorize installation.
legacybridge.install.apply_warning:
%s

Apply these results for the next launch? ADD preserves existing files; UPDATE only replaces the explicitly linked managed result. Multi-file changes are journaled, not atomic. No content activates now. Accepted installation cannot be cancelled.
legacybridge.install.recovery_warning:
%s
Journal: %s

Authorize this recovery action? Resume continues verified work; Restore attempts to restore the recorded prior state. Loaded, unknown or changed files are refused. Nothing activates in this session.
legacybridge.install.closing_after_commi: Waiting for the confirmed operation to finish safely; then Minecraft will close. Reopen through your launcher.
legacybridge.install.close_refused: Minecraft was not closed: the confirmed operation did not prove a safe completed result. Inspect details.
legacybridge.preserved.fresh_review: This observation is not confirmation authority for the current form. Request a fresh review.
legacybridge.preserved.reading_history: Reading bounded, inert history on the worker. Cancellation is available.
legacybridge.preserved.title: Preserved installation — developer only
legacybridge.preserved.warning: Experimental: logic-preserving-v1 only; explicit local full data required.
legacybridge.preserved.update.scope: Developer update: one owned, unloaded preserved ADD installation only. No chained updates, cohorts, loaded or unknown JARs.
legacybridge.preserved.update.confirm_wa:
Mod: %s
Previous: %s / replacement: %s
Current review: %s

Authorize replacement of this reviewed, unloaded managed JAR? An independent recovery copy is retained. Nothing activates now; accepted work cannot be cancelled. Apply and close requires reopening through your launcher.
legacybridge.preserved.update.recovery_w:
Update recovery: %s
Current review: %s

Authorize this exact update transaction and predecessor? The previous approval identifies recovery only; this is fresh consent. Nothing activates now. Accepted work cannot be cancelled.
legacybridge.preserved.update.recovery_o: Recovery requires the UPDATE transaction, its plan hash and prior approval; Previous still identifies its ADD predecessor. No fresh version preview is inferred from history.
legacybridge.preserved.manual_restart: Apply and close — reopen through your launcher. No automatic restart provider.
legacybridge.preserved.refused: Request refused. Inspect the result and request a fresh review.
legacybridge.preserved.invalid: Invalid %s. Use explicit absolute paths, lowercase SHA-256 and an exact UUID.
legacybridge.preserved.confirm_warning:
Action: %s
Current review: %s

Authorize this exact reviewed selection? Only new managed files or explicit recovery are allowed. No content activates now. Accepted installation cannot be cancelled. For Apply and close, reopen through your launcher afterward.
legacybridge.preserved.busy: Revalidating/installing; accepted work cannot be cancelled. Wait for its receipt.
legacybridge.preserved.cancel_requested: History cancellation requested; installation consent is not restored.
legacybridge.preserved.close_refused: Minecraft was not closed: the confirmed operation did not finish safely. Inspect the result.
legacybridge.preserved.not_active: Activation: NOT_OBSERVED. Disk installation is not proof of runtime behavior.
legacybridge.preserved.history_inert: Read-only history. No current file checks, consent, latest-result inference or activation authority.
legacybridge.preparation.title: Preserved preparation — developer only
legacybridge.preparation.warning: Finite logic-preserving-v1 only. Preparing never installs or proves game behavior.
legacybridge.preparation.cancel_requeste: Cancellation requested. A previously completed staged JAR may remain; no incomplete result is ready.
legacybridge.preparation.refused: Request refused. Inspect details and the selected operation.
legacybridge.preparation.invalid: Invalid %s. Select an absolute normalized path or exact lowercase SHA-256.
legacybridge.preparation.separate_approv: Use admission only fills the review form. Review and explicit install confirmation are still required.
